record.title: Calcutta HC declines urgent hearing for cricketer in rape case
record.summary: A state cricketer faces allegations in a rape case in Kolkata. The Calcutta High Court declined to grant an urgent hearing to the accused cricketer. The case is currently pending in court.
record.verification_note: The source report confirms a legal proceeding in the Calcutta High Court regarding an alleged rape case, consistent with the record.
